{{Image}}
Standard equipment for explorers, colonists, and adventurers and a part of any well-equipped survival kit, '''condenser units''' radiated large amounts of heat with minimal power usage. These were also referred to as '''warming units''' or '''thermal coils''' and could also be used for cooking.

[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] used one of these when he journeyed to [[Dagobah/Legends|Dagobah]] after the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]].
